name: Akaneiro
source:
Akaneiro is a dark fairy tale set in the dreamlike world of feudal Japan, continuing the story of Little Red Riding Hood. 

Akaneiro - "Angry Red" - discovers a magic scroll, and she is pulled into a tale that is all-too familiar - or is it?

[From [url=http://www.spicypony.cn/akaneiro/]Official site[/url]]
translation:
《Akaneiro》是一部以梦幻般的封建日本为舞台的黑暗童话，延续了《小红帽》的故事。

茜红——意为“愤怒的红色”——发现了一卷魔法卷轴，并被卷入一个似曾相识的故事中……真的是这样吗？

[摘自[url=http://www.spicypony.cn/akaneiro/]官方网站[/url]]
